classification.difficultyReason: Draw nested right triangles with A between B and the building, find the shared height as requested, then use tangent to find the full baseline and subtract 12 m to obtain x.

content.prompt: At a point $A$ on the ground, $12\text{ m}$ from the base of a building, the angle of elevation of the top of the building is $51^\circ$. From a point $B$ on the ground, $x\text{ m}$ further out from $A$, in line with the base of the building, the angle of elevation is $40^\circ$.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw a diagram to represent the information above.

answer.short: A labelled diagram with $A$ between $B$ and the building, as shown.
answer.worked: Draw the building perpendicular to the ground. Put $A$ $12\text{ m}$ from its base and $B$ a further $x\text{ m}$ away. Join both points to the top and label the elevation angles.

spec.description: Two observation points on the same side of a vertical building.
spec.mathematics: AO=12 m, BA=x m, elevation angles 51 degrees at A and 40 degrees at B.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the height of the building to the nearest centimetre.

answer.worked:
Let the building height be $h\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan51^\circ&=\frac{h}{12}\\h&=12\tan51^\circ\\h&\approx14.82\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the value of $x$, correct to the nearest centimetre.

answer.short:
$x=5.66\text{ m}$

Use the unrounded height to find the full distance from $B$ to the building, then subtract $12\text{ m}$.
answer.worked:
Retain the unrounded height from part b.
$$\begin{align*}\tan40^\circ&=\frac{h}{12+x}\\12+x&=\frac{h}{\tan40^\circ}\\x&=\frac{12\tan51^\circ}{\tan40^\circ}-12\\x&\approx5.66\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
